\section[vṛkṣaḥ]{\sk{वृक्षः} (vṛkṣaḥ) — a tree}

\label{lesson:SA-C81-tree}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Sanskrit for a tortoise, then the Sanskrit for a frog.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \sk{वृक्षः}}
\textbf{\sk{वृक्षः}} (\emph{vṛkṣaḥ}) — \textquotedblleft{}a tree\textquotedblright{}, the everyday word beside \textbf{\sk{तरुः}}.

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
A second word for tree.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{vṛkṣaḥ}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{vṛkṣaḥ}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} say \emph{vṛkṣaḥ}
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Sanskrit for a tortoise, then the Sanskrit for a frog, then say \emph{vṛkṣaḥ} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \sk{वृक्षः} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}A tree\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[bījam]{\sk{बीजम्} (bījam) — a seed}

\label{lesson:SA-C81-seed}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Sanskrit for a frog, then the Sanskrit for a tree.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \sk{बीजम्}}
\textbf{\sk{बीजम्}} (\emph{bījam}) — \textquotedblleft{}a seed\textquotedblright{}, the start of every \textbf{\sk{वृक्षः}}.

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
Where a tree begins.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{bījam}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{bījam}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} say \emph{bījam}
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Sanskrit for a frog, then the Sanskrit for a tree, then say \emph{bījam} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \sk{बीजम्} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}A seed\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
What holds the tree down.
